fns_divergence_note: CAUTION — large FNS divergence: FNS FY2022 rates PA participation at 100% (capped) under full eligibility rules, i.e. a statistically-zero gap; this gross-income-only fact base shows 803K persons in non-receipt households. In PA the proxy's known upward biases dominate. Use these figures ONLY as geographic ranking (which counties, relative need), never as an absolute-gap claim; pitch framing should lean on consent-order geographies (ESSA/Citadel — Philadelphia) and the NTI cluster, not on a headline gap number.
